rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; archived p946 (2025) p. 34 requires fourth-quarter bases to be more than 40% of the annual bases. The returned multiply_rate rounds the 40% product to cents under the shared IR, which changes this strict comparison. Counterexample: annual basis $1000.02 and Q4 basis $400.01. Exact 40% is $400.008, so the source test is true (5*40001 > 2*100002); the returned rate multiplication rounds to $400.01 and its strict comparison is false. This arithmetic failure remains even if its collection aggregation is supplied correctly. One model error out of one judged line exceeds the noise limit; this run earns no assertion.
